process.name: Internal project handoff preparation
process.purpose: Prepare a handoff packet for human review before it enters the project queue.
process.start_condition: A project lead marks a handoff as ready for review.
process.finish_condition: A named coordinator accepts or returns the packet; the AI does not route it.
